entries.mechanism: TAXSIM runs at its latest 2024 law year. Maine indexes the section 5111 bracket boundaries and the section 5124-C standard deduction annually (section 5111 subsection 1-F); the residual is the 2024-to-2026 indexation vintage of those bracket and deduction amounts (higher 2024 tax at mid income, lower at the first bracket). The pipeline reports 565.5; TAXSIM 2024 reports 562.04. Indexation vintage, not a pipeline defect; the pipeline matches PolicyEngine me_income_tax_before_refundable_credits at 2026 to the cent.
